item.title: NCRF and WZRD talk Latino College Expo — WZRDchicago
item.description: This Thursday April 4th Northeastern is excited to host NCRF’s first Latino College Expo in the Midwest. Listen and find out more about their mission and how NEIU is part of helping underserved youth attain a college education and experience.
